name: Iris Reinfeldt
original_name: アイリス・ラインフェルト
source:
Hobbies: Taking walks, moonlight bathing
Skills: Magic
Weakness: Socializing

A first-year student who is the current student council president of the west tower and the [url=/c45472]principal's[/url] only daughter. Controlling light-type magic, Iris has the best potential and skill among the school, which is almost equal with her mother's. She came to Japan this spring in order to apply to a high school there, and she stays at the [url=/c42753]protagonist's[/url] home. She became the new student council president only because [url=/c42543]Sharifa[/url] and the other members thought it would be a good idea.

Though she is very hardworking in both school work and other chores, Iris is also extremely shy and has a hard time getting used to campus life. She does her best so she can be complimented more by her dear mother, whom she loves very much.
